outcome_statement: A real, callable Cross-Domain Personal Intelligence service maintains per-domain data silos with sensitivity policies, answers cross-domain questions by combining only consented domains/fields, blocks sensitive domains without explicit consent, and logs every access and consent grant.
pain: Calendar/tasks/finance/health/contacts live in separate silos with no shared way to answer a cross-domain question without either a one-off integration per question, or an undifferentiated blob that ignores what's actually sensitive.
value: One system that can answer real cross-domain questions correctly, while sensitive domains never leak without explicit consent -- audited, not assumed.
success_metrics: Domain/PersonalIntelligence classes match the proven prototype's (scripts/prototype-cross-domain-v5.mjs, 12/12 tests) exact consent/inference behavior -- a sensitive domain never appears in an answer without explicit prior consent
failure_metrics: A sensitive domain's data appearing in a cross-domain answer without explicit consent
constraints: BuilderOS system path only -- no agent hand-build
Requires V4 evidence/action loop across at least two domains to mean anything real, per blueprint order
unacceptable_result: A consent leak between domains; reinvented inference logic that doesn't match the proven prototype; real data-source integration (out of scope)
ownership: ARC emits machine twin; Builder executes; Adam owns founder usability verdict

point_model.A: Vision — Adam provides FP in development stage
point_model.B: Chair locks handoff — corridor protected; Adam done until Alpha
